candidates.violated_requirement: The output match should be asserted only when the shift register equals 8'b0111_0001, but the mutant requires an additional condition that the LSB is 1. This will fail when a_tem is 8'b0111_0001 but a_tem[0] is 0.
candidates.spec_basis: The spec states 'The output match should be asserted (logic 1) whenever the value of the shift register a_tem matches the specific 8-bit pattern 8'b0111_0001'.
